status: authoritative source selected; GitHub extraction and application/native comparison pending
source: LibriSpeech ASR corpus, OpenSLR SLR12, test-clean split
attribution: LibriSpeech, Vassil Panayotov, Daniel Povey and collaborators; read audiobook recordings from LibriVox, distributed by OpenSLR, 2015.
provenance: Documented human-read English audiobook corpus. FLAC members are retained unchanged from the publisher archive; corpus recordings were segmented/aligned from LibriVox recordings before distribution. They are not untouched microphone capture files. Publisher transcript is retained for each selected member.
selection: First two archive members between 20.137931 and 25 seconds, from distinct speaker IDs, at least 16000Hz mono; selection is deterministic in archive order. Actual member names and source SHA-256 values are recorded by the server extraction report.

derivative.modifications: Fractional trim, decoding, resampling and mono-to-stereo duplication only. No generated speech, voice model, denoising, normalization, silence padding or remote transcription service. Original FLAC stays available separately.

scope: Human-source provenance and deterministic fixtures only. Source membership, human transcription agreement, perceptual quality and output retention are separate checks. MD5 is the publisher's archive integrity identifier; newly measured SHA-256 hashes provide reproducibility rather than a pre-existing publisher SHA-256 guarantee.
